exact_laws.launcher_callback_binding: 0x1415710b0 binds show_power_balance to callback object country_politics_view+0x2dc0; the constructor initializes that callback with 0x141570450.

exact_laws.close_transition: 0x141c49570 invokes hide on controller GUI root+0x30 and writes controller+0x30=0.
exact_laws.open_transition: 0x141c4a6b0 invokes show on controller GUI root+0x30, writes controller+0x30=1, selects the first matching balance, and clears the byte again if no match exists.
exact_laws.click_toggle: 0x141570450 reads controller+0x30; open routes to 0x141c49570, closed first closes competing politics panels then routes to 0x141c4a6b0.
exact_laws.launcher_visibility: While the country-politics surface is active, 0x141570510 hides launcher root country_politics_view+0x7ba0 when the first-match selector returns the null object and shows it otherwise. The actual container state is bit 0x08 at launcher_root+0xa5.
exact_laws.panel_gui_visibility: The controller GUI root is controller+0x48; the show/hide receiver is root+0x30 and the matching logical-visible bit is root+0xa5 bit 0x08.
exact_laws.refresh_consistency: If the controller open byte is set, 0x141570510 calls 0x141c4a860. That refresh closes the panel on no match, or updates controller+0x598 to the same first-match record before terminal post-refresh.
exact_laws.capture_boundary: A terminal 0x141c4baa0 sample is admissible only with controller+0x30=1 and controller GUI root+0xa5 bit 0x08 set. Launcher refresh and click samples additionally bind the country-politics and controller vtables, executing thread, selected-record relationship, and GUI visibility bits.
